TERMS &amp; CONDITIONS: BOOKING FORM 
 
 
 The booking or reservation of the unit (details specified over leaf) is subject to the terms and conditions stated hereunder. Upon payment of thirty percent (30%) down payment by the Buyer, the Buyer shall execute the agreement to sell with the Developer on revised terms and conditions stated therein. 
 
 Payment 
 
 Full and final down payment must be deposited, in piecemeal or lump sum, within seven (7) working days from the date of signing of th is booking form . 
 Payment will be accepted in cash , online bank transfer and/or through a bank instrument only drawn in favour of the authorized representative of Zameen Omega (SMC-PVT) Limited ( “ Developer ” ) as specified in para 7 below . 
 In the event that any payment is made through online bank transfer or cash deposit, the buyer must present proof of payment to the Developer in order to obtain the receipt. 
 If the buyer is not currently residing in Pakistan , t he buyer may collect the original receipt at any time, either personally or through a duly authorised representative. 
 Any payment in a currency other than Pakistani Rupee s will be subject to conversion based on applicable bank exchange rates, and any bank charges and/or reversal charges, in case charged by the bank, shall be borne by the buyer . 
 All bank instruments must be made payable to “ Zameen Omega ( SMC- P VT) Limited ” or such other designated bank account as may be notified by Zameen Omega (SMC-PVT ) Limited . Payment (s) to any other bank account or any other entity or person other than specified herein will not be accepted.

 If any payment is made through cheque and the cheque is dishonoured, the Developer reserves the right to cancel the booking , without prejudice to any other rights or remedies available to the Developer under the law. 
 The Buyer shall be solely responsible for all taxes, levies, transfer fees, rates, assessments, utilities and other charges with respect to the purchased u nit as applicable from time to time by relevant federal, provincial and local authorities. 
 
 Booking of Unit 
 
 This booking is conditional upon full and final payment of the down payment by the buyer to the Developer through its authorized representative . Any delay or failure to pay the down payment within the stipulated time sha ll result in immediate cancellation of the booking without any further notice and deduction shall be applicable as per clause 16 below . 
 Booking of the unit shall be confirmed on realisation of down payment in clear funds in the designated bank account of Developer’s authorized representative and thereafter the buyer shall have fourteen (14) days for signing the agreement to sell after which the instalment plan will commence. 
 If the buyer or her/his authorised representative is not available for signing within the prescribed time, the De veloper reserves the right to cancel the booking at its sole discretion . 
 The Buyer shall have no right or title in respect of the booked unit until the execution of the agreement to sell and fulfilment of buyer ’s obligations thereunder, including full and final payment of sale price with respect to the purchase of the booked unit. 
 
 Cancellation &amp; Refund 
 
 In case of cancellation of booking within three (3) days from the date of signing of this booking form , the Developer shall refund , subject to submission of refund request the Buyer, any payment made /deposited by the Buyer without any de du ction whatsoever . 
 In case of cancellation of booking after laps of three (3) days from the date of signing of this booking form or before execution of agreement to sell , any payment ( s ) made by the buyer shall be refunded by the Developer after deduction of a cancellation fee of fifteen percent (15% ) of the purchase p rice . 
 In case of cancellation of booking after execution of agreement to sell , the terms of the agreement to sell shall be applicable. 
 In the event the buyer fails to fulfil its payment and other obligations under the terms of this booking form within the time periods stipulated herein , the Developer reserves the r i ght to cancel the booking at its sole discretion and deduction under clause 16 above shall be applicable . 
 
 General 
 
 The buyer acknowledges and agrees that this booking form does not create any contractual relationship between the buyer and Zameen Omega ( SMC-PVT) Limited. 
 The buyer undertakes and confirms that a ll information provided in this booking form is true, complete and accurate . 
 This booking is non-transferable and any attempt to transfer made by the buyer without prior written approval of the Developer shall be void, and shall result in immediate cancellation of th e book ed unit . 
 This booking form is not proof of ownership and does not qualify as a title or ownership document, nor does it transfer any right or create any interest in any property to or in favour of the buyer. 
 The buyer understands and confirms that Zameen Omega ( SMC-PVT) Limited shall not be responsible or liable in any manner whatsoever with respect to any unit/property booked or purchased from the Developer or any payments made in lieu thereof. 
 If any term of this booking form is held invalid, illegal or unenforceable, the validity, legality and enforceability of the remaining terms shall not in any way be affected or impaired as a result thereof . 
 These terms shall be governed by the laws of Pakistan. 
 The agreement to sell shall supersede and override these terms and conditions along with any and all prior agreements, understandings and negotiations, written or oral, direct or indirect between the Developer and the buyer. 
 Any dispute arising out of or in relation to the booking of the unit or the subject matter hereof , if not resolved within 15 (fifteen) days, shall be referred to arbitration under the Arbitration Act 1940. The p a rties shall appoint an arbitrator with mutual consent. The seat of arbitration shall be in Lahore and the language for arbitration proceedings shall be English. 
 All literature or marketing material , advertisements, logos and designs with respect to the project are exclusively owned by the Developer and reproduction of the same in whole or in part thereof , in any form is strictly prohibited.
